source_title: Sea link lights up for SRK's birthday; Mannat turns into giant screen
source_excerpt: Shah Rukh Khan is going all out to make his birthday a special one for all his fans.With buzz that the birthday boy will not make a public appearance for Monday's celebrations, he seems to be making up for it, by going the extra mile with his film promotions. On Saturday night, fans took to social media to share videos of the city's iconic Sea Link lighting up as part of the film's promotional campaign. Images of the landmark featuring SRK's movie poster have been going viral on social media, with fans saying that the city is now in 'KING mode'.Meanwhile, as fans gathered outside Mannat, photos and videos shared on social media have offered glimpses of the preparations on for the film's promotions. Amid buzz that the actor's residence will host a live projection of the teaser for 'King' on November 2, fans noted that the building has been converted into a large screen of sorts.The birthday celebrations are expected to feature the premiere of the film's teaser and a first track sung by Arijit Singh. However, Shah Rukh is not expected to be physically present at Mannat for the celebrations, owing to his work commitments.'King' is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on December 24, 2026. The film features Shah Rukh Khan alongside his daughter Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan. The film is SRK's next big release after the blockbusters 'Pathaan' and 'Jawan', both of which crossed the Rs 1,000 crore mark at the box office.'King' will face stiff competition at the Indian and international box offices with its release coming just a week after 'Avengers: Doomsday' and 'Dune: Part Three'. With 'Dune' taking over all IMAX screens and 'Doomsday' booking other large-screen formats, it will be interesting to see how 'King' maintains its release or opts for a later release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
